questions.prompt: Which claim especially makes Dewdrop doubt the new fish?
choices: It says it has been here longer than the Hollow Oak.
It says its bright blue stripe is new.
It says there are cold places in the stream.
questions.answer: It says it has been here longer than the Hollow Oak.
questions.evidenceText: I have been here longer than the Hollow Oak, said the fish. Dewdrop looked carefully. The fish was, if anything, quite new-looking.

questions.prompt: Why has the new fish been telling untrue stories?
choices: It is new and wants to sound interesting.
It wants Dewdrop to leave the stream.
It has forgotten every true thing it knows.
questions.answer: It is new and wants to sound interesting.
questions.evidenceText: Because I am new here, said the fish. And I wanted to sound interesting.

questions.prompt: What lesson does Dewdrop help the blue-striped fish understand?
choices: You do not need invented stories to be interesting.
The blue stripe proves the fish's oldest claim is true.
Knowing Deep Dark secrets is what makes the fish welcome.
questions.answer: You do not need invented stories to be interesting.
questions.rationale: The fish admits it invented stories because it was new and wanted to sound interesting, but Dewdrop says being the only blue-stripe fish is enough; this shows it does not need invented stories to be interesting.
questions.evidenceText: Is being the only blue-stripe fish enough? asked the fish. Yes, said Dewdrop. It is very enough.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: Because I am new here, said the fish. And I wanted to sound interesting.
